_comment: Single source of truth for every legacy URL this rebuild must not silently 404 on. Consumed by scripts/build.js (generates a noindex, meta-refresh compatibility bridge page at each `from` route for the GitHub Pages preview — see docs/legacy-url-migration.md for why that is NOT a real 301) and scripts/build-redirects.js (generates redirects/_redirects and redirects/redirects.json, the host-agnostic real-redirect configuration for the eventual production host). Every `from` is listed without a trailing slash; both the trailing and non-trailing variant are generated wherever host config is emitted, since most redirect engines match them as distinct literal rules.
